text:
sam (SRE): Proposal: run a 2-incident pilot for a tighter postmortem follow-up flow. Goal: reduce open remediation age and surface recurring buckets quickly.

Nina: 👍 curious what 'tighter' means in practice.

sam (SRE): Keep it light: every action gets owner + explicit due_date + 3-phase status (triage -> fix -> verify). We do a single 25-30m weekly sync until all actions closed.

leo: can we see a concrete tracker row example? makes it easier to adopt.

sam (SRE): sure, example row: ```ID: PM-2026-01-A1 | owner: leo | svc: auth | bucket: db-conn-pool | priority: P1 | due: 2026-02-03 | status: triage | recurrence: false | verify_link: <dash-url>```

carol: add small rc_bucket enum (infra/config/deploy/third_party) and a 'regression_risk' boolean. Helps rollup.

sam (SRE): agreed. Also propose these small SLOs for pilot: triage by 48h, remediation plan within 7d (for P0/P1), verification within 3d after deploy. If blocked >7d, mark blocked + escalate to oncall lead.

Nina: on the rotation front: our monthly IC handoffs cause continuity gaps. propose 6-week IC windows with 1-week overlap for handoff and shadowing. That overlap week also acts as the follow-through handoff for open actions.

leo: love the overlap idea. reduces churn.

onsite-bot: automated: "Reminder: 2 open postmortem actions assigned to leo >3 days. Use /pm-list to view."

sam (SRE): automation plan: ops-bot posts reminders at 48h and 7d, auto-creates a follow-through label on incident, and transitions to 'stale' if no progress after 14d (then auto-assigns review owner from rotation pool).

carol: please keep verification minimal: require 2 things to close: 1) one-line verification note + 2) link to dashboard or smoke-test snippet. otherwise people never close.

Nina: weekly sync invite template (paste into calendar):
"Postmortem Follow-Through Sync
Agenda:
- Round robin: 3m per owner updates
- Blockers: 10m escalate/help triage
- Patterns: 10m quick check for recurring buckets
- Next steps: 5m owners/due dates"

leo: can the tracker surface repeated buckets so we don't repeat work?

sam (SRE): yes - we'll tag rows with svc+bucket+rc_bucket+30d-window. simple query: group by svc,bucket where count>1 => flag for recurrence review. If flagged twice within 60d, schedule a deeper RCA review.

carol: who runs the pilot and how long?

sam (SRE): proposal: run pilot for the next two Sev2/Sev1 incidents assigned to oncall team (IDs: 4201, 4207). Duration: until both follow-through windows close or 30 days. Marta from ops volunteered? (marta is OOO so Nina will take lead).

Nina: i'll run the pilot, host the weekly syncs, and keep a 1-page after-action note with metrics: median time-to-verify, # stale transitions, recurrence flags.

onsite-bot: automated: "Label follow-through-pilot applied to incidents 4201, 4207."

leo: if pilot successful, next steps = small repo with tracker template + ops-bot scripts + doc with IC overlap recommendation. Keep it low-friction so teams adopt.

sam (SRE): i will draft the one-pager + tracker CSV template and drop in #eng-oncall by EOD tomorrow. Nina will kick off the first sync next Wednesday. Thanks all.

carol: quick nit: make sure the bot reminders DM owners only (not full channel spam).

sam (SRE): yes. bot will DM + post summary in the follow-through thread only.

Nina: sounds good. looking forward to the pilot.
